0022600160.text: The Hawks (3-4, 2-2 on the road) have dropped their last game, and they sit 2nd in the Southeast, 0.5 games back, and 7th in the East. The Pacers (2-5, 0-3 at home) have lost four straight and are 12th in the East, and they are currently without Aaron Nesmith, Andrew Nembhard, Ben Sheppard, Ivica Zubac, Johnny Furphy, Pascal Siakam, T.J. McConnell and Tyrese Haliburton, while Larry Nance Jr. and Obi Toppin are day-to-day. Atlanta is without Henri Veesaar, Jock Landale, Mouhamed Gueye and Kingston Flemings (serving a suspension), and Jalen Johnson is day-to-day with an ankle injury, while the Hawks lost 129-124 at Indiana on January 31, 2026, after winning the 2025-26 season series 2-1.
